sentences.translation: I will try to fix that hand.
Mother is standing up for a long time today.
I'm asking something with my hands.
My mother's hands have been sluggish.
There is a little swab above my hand.
A mother is raking dirt at the back.
I'll pull something out of the dirt.
My hands are swept away by the dirt.
Put your hands in the dirt, pull them, and pull them again.
"It's true," I say, a little bit.
A mother raises her hand by the river.
The water is on my hand.
The mother's hands are in the water.
I can put my hands in the water.
My mother will call on my children's books.
My mother's hand is holding a book.
A large hand has a small book.
I have a sieve in my hand.
The soil is swirling with a thick sieve.
My mother gets a little bit better.
I will hold my mother's hand, too.
"Today, did you get caught?" asked my mother.
My mother's hand will come to my side.
I want to go with that.
But my mother's hands are warm.
Come, pull, come, and get busy.
I think one day I will give a good thought to my mother's hand.
I'm sorry to hear you see this hand today.
My mother's hand is here now.
